tools.name: add_current_product_to_cart
tools.description: Add the product currently displayed on this product page to the cart, with the currently selected variant (size/color). Select the desired variant on the page first, then call this. Only works on product pages.

tools.name: add_to_cart
tools.description: Add a product to the shopping cart. For products with variants (size, color), id_product_attribute is REQUIRED — it is the combination ID. You can find it on the product page URL after selecting a variant (e.g. /123-456-tshirt.html#/1-rozmiar-m or ?id_product_attribute=456) or in the hidden input [name=id_product_attribute] on the product page.

id_product_attribute.description: Combination (variant) ID. Omit or 0 only for products without variants.

tools.name: get_cart_summary
tools.description: Get the current cart contents and total.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the store catalog for products matching a query. Navigates to the search results page.
